rows.finding: 84 thermal/projection fields are not independently recoverable from supplied inputs.
rows.proposed_fix: Publish velocities, all optical properties, sky/ground/cavity boundary conditions, grid, weights, converged day/night profiles and residuals; rerun both P2 and P3. The declared P2 comparison supplies a reproducible starting model.

rows.finding: Filed residual maxima do not equal extrema of the filed n=2..6 polynomial.
rows.proposed_fix: State whether maxima use raw or truncated temperatures; retain raw samples, area weights and projection coefficients; use analytic extrema and constant/linear-mode consistency checks.

rows.finding: The scalar bending estimate and a membrane-free kinematic trial do not establish full spherical-shell equilibrium.
rows.proposed_fix: Solve both curvature components, membrane/bending coupling and force/moment equilibrium with compatible thermal strains and core restraint; compare with the rough gradient screen.

rows.finding: Ti/CFRP fittings were treated as tube materials in thermal CTE and mass while SiC capacities were retained.
rows.proposed_fix: Use SiC properties for all tubes, keep fittings separate, and rerun temperatures plus compatibility. Corrected fixed-temperature sensitivities are already tabulated.

rows.finding: Every filed tube mass uses chord length; inherited capacities use arcs.
rows.proposed_fix: Charge each SiC tube's inherited arc length. Eight unique corrected masses and ten exact result mismatches are supplied.

rows.finding: The 290.634 Pa flight addition omits the selected VB baseline.
rows.proposed_fix: For the same selected local-speed case add 189.214 Pa steady pressure; total 479.848 Pa gives conditional P2 least 1.001324769. Select EAS/TAS and dynamic-response treatment consistently.

rows.finding: Negative mean Cp is not proof that uniform excess bounds a nonuniform buckling mode.
rows.proposed_fix: Compute the prestressed nonuniform pressure and hardpoint equilibrium, then compare instability/imperfection response; retain uniform excess as a screening assumption until shown.

rows.finding: The filed thickness reproduces only a logarithmic term; support and boss-loading conditions are unspecified.
rows.proposed_fix: Select edge support versus elastic foundation and finite boss loading. The supplied simply-supported uniform-patch solution includes the nonlogarithmic term and has independent boundary-condition checks.

rows.finding: Under recovered 25 mm boss-radius assumptions the systems pad radius is only 14.683 mm.
rows.proposed_fix: Define whether 25 mm is radius or diameter; enforce boss containment. The supplied 25 mm radius floor changes six-pad mass to 0.031809 kg before installation.

rows.finding: Load-only F/crush sizing omits possible existing p/2 compression and does not address pull/oblique mooring transfer.
rows.proposed_fix: Determine actual reaction direction and superpose compatible pressure loads; use available compression headroom when applicable, then check face bending, core shear, peel, local shell failure and hardware.

rows.finding: 7/2/1 member counts are scalar 5% sharing counts, without a vector load path or mass.
rows.proposed_fix: Place attachment nodes and members, solve equilibrium and joint loads, size fittings/spreaders and weigh their mass into the same lift budget.

rows.finding: The 411.299 kg reserve contains environmental lift losses and distributed masses, not one suspended payload.
rows.proposed_fix: Use the actual payload and equipment layout; label the 4.033 kN example as hypothetical. Do not convert buoyancy penalties into concentrated hardware weight.

rows.finding: Multiplying a tube mass by reciprocal least SF is not a demonstrated structural restoration and cannot repair a separate film failure.
rows.proposed_fix: Recompute changed sections, Euler/local/Perry/global modes, film, fittings, sag and lift. Use the supplied corrected proportional masses only as sensitivities.

rows.finding: The 241.317 kPa W value is typical core shear, not a bonded-interface or cyclic allowable; the minimum-average column is 172.369 kPa.
rows.proposed_fix: Choose the intended material statistic, stress-free bond temperature, finite transfer geometry and interface properties. The nominal thermal-change limits are 27.975 K typical and 19.982 K minimum-average in this screen.

rows.finding: Prescribed Al-versus-Be strain in an equivalent shear-lag formula does not include effective cellular in-plane stiffness or finite boundary conditions.
rows.proposed_fix: Model both adherends/core compatibility and effective thermal expansion, then compare with representative measured thermal-cycle shear and peel.

rows.finding: No speed or validity check is provided for Whitaker; bare optics and coating durability are assumptions.
rows.proposed_fix: Select climate and flight/ground thermal cases, validate the applicable convection regime, and retain measured or explicitly assumed surface optics and their temperature dependence.

rows.finding: Film nu is unstated, the frame is assumed rigid, and an isotropic law is applied even to the Zylon reinforcement case.
rows.proposed_fix: Provide membrane/laminate stiffness and CTE tensors, prestress and slip/bond conditions; solve frame-film compatibility with both directions and barrier mass.

rows.finding: Saying uniform mismatch does not bow a member does not evaluate circumferential tube heating, asymmetric film traction or thermal imperfections.
rows.proposed_fix: Calculate thermal curvature and load eccentricity for actual tube and attachment temperatures and add the resulting imperfection to the member stability calculation.

rows.finding: The seven-screen minimum omits unresolved assembly modes; the filed coated swing is 0.917 and a separate scalar scarf interaction is 0.980.
rows.proposed_fix: Maintain a complete mode/load-case ledger, distinguish day-rise from night-reference assembly and map core thermal shear to scarf/bond stresses before combining them. Do not present seven-screen unity as installed-hull unity.

rows.finding: 037 used 022c before 022d filed; several quoted high P3 factors are outside the half-wave band.
rows.proposed_fix: Carry the now-filed 022d in-band geometry into the next thermal/load calculation, charging both film plies and fittings. Keep this audit tied to the original 022c record.

resolved_source_findings: FAA 78-to-70-knot history is resolved by Appendix B, not a remaining document conflict.
FAA VB lower bound includes the 0.65 VH alternative; design airspeeds are EAS.
The SR-200 manufacturer's own sheet supports typical 11.3 ppm/K thermal expansion.
